space.notes: The coffee machine beside the office door, so that break_time alone can tell the coffee break from the office break early: from either bay and from the standby place both walks start in nearly the same direction (testable: the raised coffee break against the office break on one shared walk). env_layout_03 with coffee_machine_0 at (-90, 250); otherwise env_layout_03, a room of dock_loading's first tests (design_decisions.md, "T-G: the second domain's rulings", B14). T-K part 1, step 6 (design_records.md, "T-K", STEP 6, its addition). Origin at the hall's centre, y up; the space x ±600, y ±740 holds every fixed object (truck y -740 to -440, office to y 415).
